chapter.verse: Tuuhon bangin Josef a paipih, Israel Tuucingpa aw, ngai in! Nang, Kherubte tunga tu-pa aw,
Efraim leh Benjamin leh Manasseh mai-ah taangkhia in! Na tha saan in la, kote honkhia dingin hong pai in!
Ka ngei uh hong bangsak kik in, Pasian aw, kote hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taang sak in!
Vanglianpen Topa Pasian aw, na mite’ thungetna-ah nang bang tanvei sin so ding na hi hiam?
Nangmah in an dingin khitui amaute na pia a, amaute’ dawn dingin khitui tampi na pia hi.
Nangmah in, ka vengte uh’ thusim lohin kote nong bawl a, ka galte un hong thusimlohna tawh amau kinuihsan uh hi.
Ka ngei uh hong bangsak kik in, mihonpite’ Pasian aw; kote a hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taang sak in!
Nangmah in, Izipt panin leenggui khat na la a, minamte hawlkhia-in, tua leenggui na suan hi.
Nangmah in tua leenggui’ adingin lei na hahsiang a, amah in zung thuk kha-in leitang dim hi.
Ama liim in mualliante lim sun a, a hiang in taamtaak singliante khuh a,
tuipi lamah a hiangte zam-in, a dawnngekte in Gunpi lam zuan hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, lampi-a pai khempeuh in ama gah a lawh theih nadingin, bang hangin nangmah in a daigawl suvang na hi hiam?
Gamlak-a om Ngal in susia gawpin, zang sunga om ganhing khempeuh in kivakna-in nei uh hi.
Hong kihei kik in; Vanglianpen Pasian! Vantung panin ensuk in la, mu in; na khut taklam in a suansa kung hih leenggui don in.
Amaute in mei tawh hal-in sattan uh hi; amaute heh-et in la, susia in.
Ahih hangin nangma adinga na hatsak mi’ tapa, na taklam khut-a mipa tungah thahatna guan in.
Tua ciangin nang kiang panin kote ka kihei kik nawn kei ding uh hi; kote, hong nungtasak in, nangmah kong phat ding uh hi.
Ka ngei uh hong bangsak kik in, mihonpite’ Topa Pasian! Kote hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taang sak in!
